title: Webb County Utility Assistance Applications Open Monday at Five Locations
excerpt: Webb County's Community Action Agency opens applications Monday, Nov. 30, for its CEAP Light Assistance Program, with 50 applications available at each of five community centers.
content:
The Webb County Community Action Agency is opening applications Monday for its CEAP Light Assistance Program, a federally funded program that helps eligible low-income households pay utility bills, address energy crises and learn ways to lower energy costs, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Applications can be picked up Monday, Nov. 30, from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., and completed forms can be returned Tuesday, Dec. 1, or Wednesday, Dec. 2, from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Fifty applications will be available at each community center.

Applications will be available at the main Community Action Agency office, 111 Camino Nuevo Road, Highway 359, Building B; the Fernando Salinas Community Center, 520 Reynolds St., second floor; the Lilia Perez Community Center, 4420 Old Santa Maria Road; the Larga Vista Community Center, 5401 Cisneros Drive; and the Webb County Southern Public Health Facility, 1301 Paseo de los Santos Drive.

Applicants need proof of residency or citizenship, identification — a Texas ID or driver's license for anyone 18 or older, or immunization records for minors — proof of income from the past 30 days, benefits information and energy provider information for all household members.

For more information, call the Community Action Agency at 956-523-4222.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 27, 2026.
